whyItMatters: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `name/version@user/channel` reference.
actions: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a `name/version@user/channel` reference.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm conanfile.txt no longer carries a `name/version@user/channel` reference.
